name: EXM_TRAVEL_SITE_EMPLOYMENTS
description: This table contains employment roles or job management levels assigned to or excluded from a travel booking site, depending on how the employment assignment rule was defined at the travel booking site.  If all employment roles or job management levels are assigned to a travel booking site, then this table contains no records for that site.

columns.name: TRAVEL_SITE_EMPLOYMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of job management level or job role assignment or exclusion for travel booking site.

columns.name: BOOKING_SITE_ID
columns.description: Travel booking site to which employment role or grade is assigned to or excluded from.

columns.name: JOB_GRADE_POSITION_ID
columns.description: Job role from Oracle Human Resources that is assigned to or excluded from travel site.

columns.name: JOB_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Job management level from Human Capital Management (HCM) that is assigned to or excluded from travel site.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: EXCLUDED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether employment role or grade is excluded from travel site.  Value of Y means employment job or grade is excluded from travel site. Value of N means job or grade is assigned to travel site.
